en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing an industrial brick building beside a powerful river or waterfall. The structure appears to be a hydroelectric power station built into the rocky riverbank, with scaffolding and walkways along the water. Hills or low mountains rise in the background. Printed captions in Swedish identify the place as Uddevalla and refer to an electricity works and the Uddevalla Museum, with a date of February 1903.
